name: Table-Column Mismatch
input_sql: SELECT department.born_state FROM department JOIN head ON department.Department_ID = head.head_ID
repaired_sql: SELECT head.born_state FROM department JOIN head ON department.Department_ID = head.head_ID

name: Unused Alias
input_sql: SELECT department.Name FROM department AS D WHERE department.Ranking > 2
repaired_sql: SELECT D.Name FROM department AS D WHERE D.Ranking > 2

name: Missing JOIN (FK Path)
repaired_sql: SELECT department.Name, temporary_acting FROM department JOIN management ON management.department_ID = department.Department_ID

name: Implicit Type Conversion
repaired_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / 12 FROM department

name: = Instead of IN
input_sql: SELECT Name FROM department WHERE Department_ID = (SELECT department_ID FROM management)
repaired_sql: SELECT Name FROM department WHERE Department_ID IN ((SELECT department_ID FROM management))

name: Ascending Sort with NULL
repaired_sql: SELECT MIN(Num_Employees) FROM department WHERE Num_Employees IS NOT NULL

name: Comparing Unrelated Columns
input_sql: SELECT cards.name FROM cards JOIN sets ON cards.id = sets.id
repaired_sql: SELECT cards.name FROM cards JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code

name: Aggregation/Comparison Misuse
repaired_sql: SELECT MAX(CAST(born_state AS REAL)) FROM head
